en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a historic two‑story house with a large patterned tile roof and several chimneys. The building façade has rectangular windows framed by pilasters and an arched central doorway. Above the entrance appears the sign of a museum. In the background are parts of neighboring houses and a street scene with a few people. Printed Hungarian text appears in the upper corners identifying the city and the building.
